cv_sections.summary:
# Software Engineering & Architecture (10+ years): An engineer in
complex, high-quality, and scalable systems since 2011, delivering
backend solutions, integrations, and cloud-native services in
enterprise and startup environments.
# Generative AI (GenAI) Adoption & Governance: Drives practical
GenAI adoption by leading focused Proofs of Concept (PoCs),
building demo pipelines, and delivering hands-on training to create
immediate engineering improvements.
- Designs and prototypes agentic workflows, integrating tools
like GitHub Copilot and MCP to automate test generation,
documentation, code reviews, and architecture checks.
- Establishes lightweight governance, prompt-engineering standards,
and simple KPIs to track impact and manage risk, balancing delivery
with continuous experimentation and mentoring.
# Technology & Cross-Stack Proficiency: Hands-on expertise
with .NET (core/.NET), Java / Spring Boot, and JavaScript / Node.js,
comfortably selecting the optimal stack for a given business problem.
# Architecture & Design: Specializes in designing and implementing
microservices, event-driven systems, serverless components, and
cloud-native platforms, applying Domain-Driven Design (DDD) to
ensure model-business alignment.
# Quality, Testing & TDD: A strong advocate for SOLID principles,
clean code, and shared coding standards. Drives Test-Driven
Development (TDD) and comprehensive unit/integration/e2e test
suites across development teams.
# DevOps & Delivery Automation: Builds test automation and
enforces quality gates within CI/CD pipelines, creating repeatable,
risk-reducing release processes that accelerate delivery. Designs
  Page 1 of 12
   
infrastructure-as-code, automated releases, and runbooks with a
focus on production resilience and cost-awareness.
# Leadership & Mentorship: Coaches engineers, enforces
engineering standards, and leads initiatives to consistently raise
team capability and delivery quality.
# Business Analysis & Stakeholder Management: Translates
product goals into concrete technical requirements and designs.
Conducts business process evaluation, technical feasibility, and
impact analysis. Facilitates workshops and aligns Product Managers,
Architects, and Engineers to ensure teams deliver the correct
solutions quickly by removing ambiguity.
